bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed"
sha=e9cc45dd68d93cf237dc7e6117090983d6aa9043
test "$(git -C "$target" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true || { echo EXISTING_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND; exit 61; }
test -z "$(git -C "$target" status --porcelain)" || { echo EXISTING_SOURCE_DIRTY; exit 62; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null)" = true || { echo BOT_NOT_RUNNING; exit 63; }
test "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'createvdobot|create-videobot|videobot-poll' || true)" -eq 1 || { echo MULTIPLE_BOT_CONSUMERS; exit 64; }
git -C "$target" fetch --no-tags origin "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git -C "$target" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo FETCH_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 65; }
git -C "$target" checkout --detach "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1
test -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 66
docker build --pull=false -t create-videobot:menu-home-e9cc45d -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" "$target" >/dev/null
img=create-videobot:menu-home-e9cc45d
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint grep "$img" -q 'ステッカー・絵文字' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs || exit 67
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint grep "$img" -q 'plain /start belongs to the common home menu' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 68
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" || exit 69
pg=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$pg")" = true || exit 70
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net=deploy_default
pin="$HOME/.local/state/create-videobot/sticker-pin"
test -f "$pin/group2373696859_thread4640.json" || exit 71
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass" VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$pin" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
compose="$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" config --quiet
armed=0
restore(){ docker image tag create-videobot:menu-before-fix create-videobot:local-poll; docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo BOT_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED; }
trap 'if test "$armed" = 1; then restore; fi' EXIT
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:menu-before-fix
armed=1
docker image tag "$img" create-videobot:local-poll
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 72
docker exec "$n" grep -q 'plain /start belongs to the common home menu' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 73
docker logs --tail 900 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 74
docker logs --tail 900 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || exit 75
test "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'createvdobot|create-videobot|videobot-poll' || true)" -eq 1 || exit 76
armed=0
echo CREATEVDOBOT_MENU_HOME_RUNTIME=PASS
echo CREATEVDOBOT_DEPLOYED_SHA="$sha"
